red_green_sequence.description: Wrote tests/test_heatmap_role_aware.py with 5 failing tests before any implementation.
failures: test_heatmap_empty_input_raises_clear_error — TypeError: unexpected keyword argument 'sensor_roles' (no ValueError raised)
test_heatmap_call_site_uses_helper — AssertionError: build_sensor_role_map not found in render()

red_green_sequence.description: Initial test used T2 as override target but T2 was already the core sensor (priority wins). Test revised to dynamically pick a sensor that is neither 'surface' nor 'core'.
Loader has no get_curve_data() method. Test revised to use loader.all_curves[curve_idx]['data'] (correct pattern from loader.py).
All 5 new tests pass after implementation.

src/visualization/plots.py.line_9: Added SENSOR_LIST to imports from config.constants.

plot_temperature_gradient_heatmap.signature_change: Added sensors: Optional[List[str]] = None, sensor_roles: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None parameters.
plot_temperature_gradient_heatmap.filter_present: Filter to sensors present in data.columns before building heatmap_array.
plot_temperature_gradient_heatmap.empty_input_guard: Raises ValueError if no present sensors found.
plot_temperature_gradient_heatmap.y_labels: Respects sensor_roles dict: appends (Role.capitalize()) suffix when role != 'unknown'.
plot_temperature_gradient_heatmap.backwards_compat: sensor_roles=None falls back to firmware-default SENSOR_NAMES labels (no suffix).

tabs/temperature_profile.py.heatmap_call_site: Lines 82-86: now calls build_sensor_role_map(loader, current_curve_index) and passes sensor_roles=heatmap_roles to plot_temperature_gradient_heatmap.
tabs/temperature_profile.py.pattern_a_unchanged: Lines 22-38 (Pattern A label loop) not modified — M3 scope.
tabs/temperature_profile.py.pattern_b_unchanged: Lines 52-68 (Pattern B role loop for line plot) not modified — M3 scope.

empty_input_contract.message: No sensor columns in data; expected at least one of T1..T8.
empty_input_contract.rationale: Empty input is a programming error. Returning a silent empty figure would hide bugs; a ValueError with a clear message surfaces the problem immediately and is trivially testable without inspecting figure internals.

surprises: Loader priority rules mean set_sensor_override('surface', 'T2') has no effect when T2 is already the core sensor — core takes priority. Test was revised to select a non-core, non-surface sensor as override target.
